problems.issue: Relying exclusively on a third-party social media page (Facebook) as the primary web presence lacks brand ownership and professionalism for a healthcare practice.
problems.impact: Limits credibility with potential patients who expect a dedicated, professional website with secure booking and comprehensive service details.

problems.issue: Inadequate SEO and structured data for local search visibility compared to a dedicated medical practice website with local schema markup.
problems.impact: Reduces discoverability for high-intent local search queries like 'dentist in Manila'.

problems.issue: Absence of integrated appointment scheduling, patient intake forms, and clear service pricing or insurance details.
problems.impact: Increases friction for prospective patients, leading to higher drop-off rates and missed appointment bookings.

opportunities: Develop a dedicated, mobile-responsive website featuring online appointment booking, patient testimonials, and detailed dental service pages.
Implement local SEO optimization and Google Business Profile integration to capture high-intent local patient traffic in Manila.
Showcase before-and-after case studies and practitioner credentials clearly to build immediate trust and authority.
audit.summary: Manila Dental Care Center currently relies solely on a Facebook business page, missing critical opportunities to establish professional credibility, capture local search traffic, and streamline patient appointment booking through a dedicated website.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on Manila Dental Care Center's online booking
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking up dental care options in the area and came across Manila Dental Care Center's Facebook page. While it's great for community updates, relying on social media alone can make it tough for patients to quickly check your services or book appointments online—often leading them to look elsewhere.

We actually put together a quick, lightweight website demo for you that includes integrated booking and local search setup, so new patients can find and trust you instantly.

Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

---

[{"Name":"Christian Ace Ruperto","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJtPqMoz7JeDTtfdlL_ZiVHPnaunpQb8SuDpdnZ_J9aEAVuRQ=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"My experience with this dental clinic was extremely disappointing. It felt as though they were more interested in making money than providing proper patient care.

I initially visited because my gums were severely swollen and extremely painful. I could feel a lump forming beneath my lower front gums, and even my chin had started to swell. During my visit, they performed four separate X-rays, which cost me ₱2,800, in addition to an ₱800 dental consultation fee. Despite paying for these X-rays, I was not even allowed to properly review the results myself. The only explanation I received was that my teeth appeared healthy, and the dentists themselves seemed confused about what was causing the swelling. In fact, two dentists had to examine my case because they could not determine the source of the problem.

Instead of providing a clear diagnosis, they strongly pushed me to undergo a root canal procedure costing ₱20,000. They warned me that if I refused, it would take around two weeks for my gums to heal and that the swelling in my chin could worsen. Since they were unable to confidently identify the cause of my condition, I decided not to proceed immediately and told them I wanted time to think about it.

Despite my symptoms, they did not prescribe any antibiotics or other medication that could address the swelling. They only gave me painkillers and sent me home.

Following my mother’s advice, I decided to observe my condition first. To my surprise, the very next day my swelling had already improved significantly, although it had not completely disappeared. I felt well enough to return to work.

However, the dental certificate they issued did not include any recommended days of rest. Since I needed documentation for work, I returned to the clinic and politely requested that they update the certificate to recommend 2–3 days of rest, explaining that I had genuinely needed time to recover. Even after I informed them that my condition was already improving, they refused. They insisted that they would only include the recommended rest days if I agreed to proceed with the ₱20,000 root canal procedure.

I found this response to be very disappointing and inconsiderate. It felt as though the documentation I needed for work was being withheld unless I agreed to an expensive treatment that I was not yet convinced was necessary. problems.issue: Heavy reliance on heavy JavaScript frameworks and polyfills (Wix Thunderbolt platform) which can slow down initial page rendering and Time to Interactive (TTI).
problems.impact: Slower load times can increase bounce rates, especially for mobile users with slower connections.

problems.issue: Truncated HTML and heavy dynamic client-side rendering architecture may hinder optimal SEO indexing by search engine crawlers.
problems.impact: Potential loss of organic search visibility and lower rankings for local dental care search queries.

opportunities: Implement structured data (schema markup for Dentist and LocalBusiness) to enhance local search snippets and Google Maps integration.
Optimize and compress high-resolution static media assets served via Wix static storage to improve Core Web Vitals (LCP and CLS).
Add a prominent, conversion-focused Call-to-Action (such as 'Book an Appointment' or click-to-call) directly in the header viewport.
audit.summary: The website is built on the Wix platform, ensuring standard responsive structure and icon sets, but suffers from potential performance overhead due to complex client-side rendering bundles. Focusing on technical SEO schema implementation and mobile conversion optimization will drive better patient acquisition.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on your site's load speed
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking over the Bocobo Dental Care Co. site and love the clean layout you have for patients.

I noticed that because it runs on a heavy client-side framework, the initial page load can lag a bit—especially on mobile. That small delay tends to push potential patients away before they even see your services, and it can quietly hurt your local search visibility.

We put together a quick, lightweight demo showing how much faster it could run. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul
